readme.note: Simulation demo: ctx.createNode() and ctx.createNodeConnector(). 'Node Factory' has no incoming connectors — on its first tick it creates a new BusinessCapability part (ctx.createPart), wires this node to it (ctx.createConnector), PLACES the new part on this view as a visible node (ctx.createNode), then PLACES the connector as a visible edge between the two (ctx.createNodeConnector) — createPart/createConnector alone never touch any view, so without these two placement calls neither the node nor the line between them would ever appear on this canvas, only in Catalogs. It then calls both createNode and createNodeConnector a SECOND time to demonstrate find-or-create: neither adds a duplicate: the same node/edge is returned unchanged. Step or Run Simulation, then watch the new 'Generated & Placed Capability' node and its connecting line appear on this canvas.

parts.label: Node Factory
parts.description: No incoming connectors — creates a new part, wires it, and places it on this view via script instead of reacting to inputs.
